explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/714: 'Is it true that ex(n; K_{r,r}) ≫ n^{2−1/r}?' (the upper bound being Kővári–Sós–Turán). The Lean statement asserts, for every r ≥ 2, a constant c > 0 (depending on r) with c·n^{2−1/r} ≤ extremalNumber n K_{r,r} for all large n, where extremalNumber n G is Mathlib's Turán number ex(n;G) and K_{r,r} = completeBipartiteGraph (Fin r) (Fin r). This is the standard reading of ≫ for each fixed r ≥ 2. Faithful (positive form of the yes/no question).
